C0887.title: Unauthorized Access Vulnerability in Driving Training System Exposes Millions of Student Records in Guangzhou
C0887.summary: In March 2022, Guangzhou police found that a driving training platform app provided by a tech company to driving schools stored over 10.7 million student personal information records (names, ID numbers, phone numbers, photos), and the data was being sold on the open web. The company had no data security management policies, applied no de-identification or encryption, and had an unauthorized access vulnerability. Police issued a warning and a 50,000 yuan fine, the first administrative case in Guangdong under the Data Security Law.
